Use the Detail view pattern. ## Decision rules - The page is a header row (title "Members" at the inline-start, one primary `Button` "Invite member" at the inline-end) above one `Card variant="outlined"` titled "Members" that holds a `Table`. Invite is the only primary action on the page. - Table columns: Member, Role, Status, and a row-actions column. The Member cell is an `Avatar` with initials, the name, and the email beneath it. The current user's name is followed by "(You)". - Change a role in place with a `Select` of 2 to 4 fixed roles. It saves at once, and a `Toast variant="success"` confirms ("Sam Ortiz is now an Admin"). On failure the `Select` reverts and a `Toast variant="danger"` says so. Role is never free text. - The row-actions menu is a `DropdownMenu` opened from an icon-only `Button variant="ghost"` (not drawn in Figma yet; Figma draws the Role as text). Its items: "Remove from workspace" as a `destructive` item. The current user's row offers "Leave workspace" instead, a separate action from removing. - Invite opens a `Dialog` titled "Invite member". The body says what happens ("They will get an email with a link to join.") and what each role can do (Owners manage billing; Admins manage members; Members edit content). It has an email `Field` and a role `Field` holding a `Select`, defaulting to the least-privileged role. The footer is `Button variant="ghost"` "Cancel" and `Button variant="primary"` "Send invite"; Send shows `loading` while the request runs. A failed invite keeps the Dialog open and the typed values, and shows the reason in an `Alert variant="danger"` inside it. - A pending invite shows a `Badge` "Pending" and the role as text ("Invited as Member"). Its row menu offers "Resend invite" and "Revoke invite" instead of a role change. - Removing a member opens an `AlertDialog variant="destructive"` titled with the person's name ("Remove Sam Ortiz?"). The description says what they lose and what they keep ("Sam loses access to this workspace and its projects immediately. Their work stays. You can invite them again later."). Cancel is first; the confirm action names the person ("Remove Sam"). Its action shows the AlertDialog `loading` state while the request runs. - The last Owner cannot be demoted or removed. Their role `Select` and their remove item are `disabled`, and the reason is written in an `Alert variant="info"` above the table with a title ("Dana Lee is the only Owner") and the way out ("Make another member an Owner before changing this role or removing Dana."). The Alert is in the page flow, not a Toast or a Tooltip, and stays until another Owner exists. - Status mapping for `Badge`: `success` Active, `warning` Pending. The row-actions menu stays at the inline-end of each row.
